citation: Drago et al. (2020). Millicar: An ns-3 Module for MmWave NR V2X Networks. WNS3. https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.10347
description: Millicar is an ns-3 module developed by the University of Padova SIGNET laboratory for vehicle-to-vehicle communication at millimetre-wave frequencies. It supplies a 3GPP V2X channel model above 6 GHz, custom physical and medium-access layers with the NR frame structure, and RLC/PDCP functionality through ns-3's LTE integration. Helpers and examples guide users in setting up road-vehicle communication scenarios. Inputs describe vehicles, traffic and radio settings; outputs are simulated network behaviour at packet and protocol level. Geographic coverage, duration and spatial detail follow the user's scenario, with no fixed real-world dataset. Public C++ source and integration instructions are free under GPL-2.0. A limitation is the dependency on the separate ns3-mmwave distribution and its compatible build environment; the README does not establish accuracy for every channel, mobility or hardware configuration. Millicar supports capacity and reliability studies of road communication systems. It is an independent extension of ns-3 (platform-ns-3), beyond the generic mmWave module named in that catalogue record. The linked WNS3 article describes the implementation; no model run was performed.
